entities.summary: Itapevi is a municipality of the West Area of the São Paulo Metropolitan Region, in the state of São Paulo, in the Southeast Region of Brazil. Born as a village of Cotia, driven by the arrival of the Estrada de Ferro Sorocabana in the 19th century, it became an emancipated municipality in 1959 after a plebiscite. It occupies an area of 82,658km², and its population in the 2022 Census was 232,297 inhabitants. It is located 35 kilometers from state capital São Paulo. and 1.017km from federal capital Brasília.
